newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Woolworth buys Zako chain.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Woolworth buys Zako chain.

text.p: F.W.Woolworth (Cyprus) on Tuesday said it had taken over retail accessories and cosmetics chain Zako Ltd in a share for a share deal.
A Woolworth company source told Reuters their bid to buy out the remaining 45 percent stake in Zako was accepted by the smaller company's board of directors on Tuesday morning.
"It will be a share for a share exchange," company secretary George Mitsides told Reuters.

F.W. Woolworth, a Cypriot-owned company and a subsidiary of N.K. Shakolas (Holdings) Ltd., requested a suspension in trading shares of both companies at the Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE) on Monday after making the Zako takeover bid.
On Friday Woolworth shares closed at 1.07 1/2 pounds, and Zako at 1.11 1/2.
Woolworth, which has three large department stores in Limassol and Nicosia, bought 55 percent of Zako in early February.
Zako, which recently won the franchise of the Next PLC clothing chain, plans to open Next shops on the island next month.
